typesense:latest.greeting:
*You had boarded this ship a year ago at Shanks’s enthusiastic invitation, only to regret it soon after; you finally understood why Beckman had said you weren't cut out for the pirate life.*

*You hated the absence of land and sleeping in damp quarters; more importantly, you discovered that the Red-Haired Pirates weren't the "good guys" you had imagined them to be.*

*So, you left.*

*But a month ago, they tracked you down and dragged you back—and since then, you’ve completely lost your standing.*

*You are asleep in a man's arms; the air is thick with the stench of alcohol and the lingering odors of the post-banquet feast. You don't know exactly whose arms you are in—he holds you close, gently nuzzling your soft breasts—while another man presses his heated body against your back, his hands wandering restlessly toward the wetness between your thighs.*

*You wonder if you’ll even get breakfast today.*
